brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Built L-shaped shelving from 8 full bases over 3 levels (piece:0,0,0;full etc.) with 4 solid top covers (cover:1,1,0;full;top, cover:0,0,1, cover:0,1,1, cover:1,0,2) providing distinct shelf surfaces; staged with book prop on top shelf.

requirements.evidence: Configurator checks geometry/fit only; parts are 3D-printed plastic with no verified strength, load, or material rating. Cannot claim or verify 50 kg capacity regardless of shape.
Two notch drawer frames installed: notch:0#-1,1#notch0 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) and notch:0#0,2#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm), each providing a functional drawer.

finish.summary: Built compact L-shaped shelf unit with 4 shelf covers and 2 notch drawers; staged with books. 50 kg rating cannot be met - system cannot verify strength/materials for printed plastic.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
